reviews.text: Water from the shower tray spread across the bathroom floor each morning.
The desk surface had sticky rings and crumbs when we checked in.
Our air conditioner blew warm air throughout the night despite the cold setting.
Small ants kept emerging from the wardrobe during our stay.
We reported a broken door latch twice, but nobody returned with an update.
The elevator stopped operating and we had to carry our suitcases up four floors.
Breakfast eggs arrived cold and the replacement was cold as well.
A loud pump outside the window woke us repeatedly after midnight.
The lake view was wonderful, although the bathroom fan rattled whenever it was switched on.
We loved the welcome drink. Unfortunately the duvet cover had dark stains.
The beds were comfortable, but the cooling system leaked onto the carpet.
Staff were friendly; however, a cockroach appeared beside the sink on both evenings.
The rooftop was delightful, yet our request for fresh towels received no answer.
Dinner tasted excellent but the corridor lighting was broken and hard to navigate.
We would return for the location, though the accessible entrance was blocked by delivery boxes.
The receptionist was cheerful, but the promised early breakfast was never available.
Fresh linen, quiet surroundings and a smooth arrival made this a relaxing visit.
Every breakfast item was hot, and the dining team refilled the trays promptly.
Our heating and cooling controls worked exactly as we expected.
The bath was spotless and hot water was available whenever we needed it.
A bulb failed on arrival; the team replaced it immediately and it worked for the rest of the stay.
It would be inconvenient if the lift broke, but it worked on every trip we made.
Please consider adding a vegan dessert to the dinner menu in future.
Adequate for one night.
